Release notes

  • The Profile Guided Optimization (PGO) feature we announced for preview in 1.20 is now generally available! If a file named default.pgo is present in the main package’s directory, the go command will use it to enable a PGO build. See the PGO documentation for more details. We’ve measured the impact on a wide set of programs and see performance improvements of 2-7%.
  • Read the setup notes first
    Install the toolchain.
    then follow the next guide to finish.
  • The go tool now supports backward compatibility settings for every release.
